checks.name: patch_hash_locking
checks.detail: Validated patches include a SHA256 lock and promotion verifies it before applying.
checks.fix: Store patch_sha256 during validation and refuse promotion if the saved patch file differs from the validation report.

checks.name: webui_js_parse
checks.fix: Fix webui.py script syntax before shipping; a parse failure can break send().

checks.name: regression_tests_present

checks.name: release_hygiene
checks.summary: Release tree has no cache/bytecode package artifacts
checks.fix: The shared zip should exclude caches; runtime-created Python caches are ignored during live Doctor checks.

recommendations: Run the validation ladder before shipping: compileall -> targeted pytest -> web UI JS parse -> Docker validation when available.
Prefer data-command buttons over inline quoted command strings in webui.py.
For autonomous changes, generate a patch, validate it in Docker, then promote only after checks pass.
Keep README, version label, CHANGELOG and release tests updated in the same commit/build.
Goal-specific next step: create a small patch for `v55.3.168 smoke`, run /docker-validate-patch, then promote only if the report passes.

commands.name: playwright_smoke
commands.summary: Skipped because Playwright is unavailable or Nova server is not reachable at http://127.0.0.1:8766

recommendations: For code-changing patches, run /docker-validate-patch and only promote hash-locked passing reports.
If Docker is available, also run /docker-validate quick after /release-gate.
If Nova is running in the browser and Playwright is installed, /release-gate now runs the GUI smoke test automatically.
